title: The Rise of a Tyrant on the Bus — Part 5

series.summary: Inside the speeding minibus, the traumatized students weep as the school vanishes in the distance. Capitalizing on their sheer terror, teacher Shido begins a cunning psychological campaign, preaching that obedience and absolute hierarchy are their only hope. Panicked students quickly fall under his spell, accepting him as their undisputed leader. But Rei Miyamoto refuses to bow down: she reveals that Shido corruptly sabotaged her academic career to spite her detective father. When Shido threatens to exile anyone who questions him, Rei demands to leave the bus, and Takashi refuses to let her go alone.

segments.voiceover_text: Inside the bus, shell-shocked students weep as the vehicle speeds away from the overrun school. Outside, black smoke billows across the ruined city.
Panicked students question the route, terrified of entering downtown. Shido seizes on their desperation, manipulating their terror to assert his own dominance.
Shido declares himself supreme commander of the survivors. But Rei trembles with rage, confronting the corrupt teacher who maliciously derailed her life before the outbreak.
Refusing to obey a tyrant, Rei demands to leave the bus. Takashi steps to her side to protect her. Are they about to be cast out into the zombie-filled streets?
